methodology: Comparison of the pre-splitting and final production builds in this change set, using the same dependency versions. The final build also includes additional cached-session validation. Initial JavaScript counts the entry and all JavaScript module-preload links in dist/index.html. Excludes CSS, images and dynamically loaded routes. Gzip sizes use Node gzipSync defaults and can differ slightly from Vite reporting. These local sizes do not measure live server wake-up time.
